note: Calamaio's listing buffers: a folder's files (C-x d, the tool bar's folder) and the buffer list (C-x C-b). Each keeps the ids or paths of its lines in entries, from line first: RET visits the one on point's line, g lists again and q leaves it.

dired.title: Open Folder...
dired.description: Lists a folder's files in a buffer; RET on a line visits that file or folder.

buffer.name: {{dir}}
buffer.text:
{{'Folder ' + dir + '    RET visits the line' + "'" + 's file, g lists again, q leaves

' + join(map(items, '  ' + (it.dir ? 'd' : '-') + pad(it.dir ? '' : text(length(it.text ?? '')), 8, ' ') + '  ' + pad(time(it.mtime, 'D MMM HH:mm'), 12, ' ') + '  ' + it.name), '
') + (length(items) == 0 ? '  (no files)' : '') + '
'}}

list-buffers.title: List Buffers
list-buffers.description: Lists the buffers, with their size, mode and file; RET on a line shows that buffer.

buffer.name: *Buffer List*
buffer.text:
{{'Buffers    RET shows the line' + "'" + 's buffer, g lists again, q leaves

  ' + slice('Name' + pad('', 22, ' '), 0, max(22, length('Name'))) + slice('Size' + pad('', 8, ' '), 0, max(8, length('Size'))) + slice('Mode' + pad('', 18, ' '), 0, max(18, length('Mode'))) + 'File
  ' + slice('----' + pad('', 22, ' '), 0, max(22, length('----'))) + slice('----' + pad('', 8, ' '), 0, max(8, length('----'))) + slice('----' + pad('', 18, ' '), 0, max(18, length('----'))) + '----
' + join(map(filter(state.order, it != 'bl'), (state.bufs[it].dirty ? '* ' : state.bufs[it].readOnly ? '% ' : '  ') + slice(state.bufs[it].name + pad('', 22, ' '), 0, max(22, length(state.bufs[it].name))) + slice(text(length(state.bufs[it].text ?? '')) + pad('', 8, ' '), 0, max(8, length(text(length(state.bufs[it].text ?? ''))))) + slice(state.modes[state.bufs[it].mode].title + pad('', 18, ' '), 0, max(18, length(state.modes[state.bufs[it].mode].title))) + (state.bufs[it].file ?? '')), '
') + '
'}}

listing-visit.title: Visit This Line
listing-visit.description: In a folder or buffer listing, visits the file, folder or buffer on point's line.

listing-revert.title: List Again
listing-revert.description: Makes a folder or buffer listing again, with what changed since.

quit-window.title: Leave This Buffer
quit-window.description: Shows the buffer before this one in the window (in a listing or a help buffer).

computed.fileInfo: {{map(range(length(state.files)), merge(state.files[it], {name: computed.fileNames[it], parent: slice(state.files[it].path, 0, length(state.files[it].path) - length(computed.fileNames[it]))}))}}
